# XcellHost Cloud Services

> XcellHost Cloud Services Pvt. Ltd. is a managed cloud and cybersecurity provider based in Mumbai, India, operating since 1999. It serves 10,000+ Indian businesses with managed AWS, Azure, GCP and Oracle Cloud, private and hybrid cloud, backup and disaster recovery, Tally on Cloud, DPDPA compliance and a 24x7 NOC + SOC. XcellHost is ISO 27001 and ISO 20000-1 certified.

Key facts:
- Legal name: XcellHost Cloud Services Pvt. Ltd. (brand: XcellHost)
- Founded: 1999 · Headquarters: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
- Certifications: ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 20000-1
- Operations: 24x7 Network Operations Centre (NOC) and Security Operations Centre (SOC)
- Customers: 10,000+ businesses in India, plus white-label managed cloud for partners
- Tally on Cloud: from ₹499 per user
- Sales: sales@xcellhost.cloud · +91-22-67111555

## Managed cloud

- [Managed Google Cloud](https://xcellhost.cloud/managed-google-cloud-gcp/): GCP operations and support
- [Managed Oracle Cloud](https://xcellhost.cloud/managed-oracle-cloud/)
- [Managed multi-cloud](https://xcellhost.cloud/managed-multi-cloud/)
- [Managed Kubernetes](https://xcellhost.cloud/managed-kubernetes/)
- [AWS migration](https://xcellhost.cloud/aws-migration/), [Azure migration](https://xcellhost.cloud/azure-migration/), [GCP migration](https://xcellhost.cloud/gcp-migration/)
- [GPU servers](https://xcellhost.cloud/gpu-servers/) and [GPU clusters](https://xcellhost.cloud/gpu-clusters/)
